copy.tagline: 启动并调试 tinywasm 开发环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 tinywasm 进行 WebAssembly 开发
copy.tagline_en: Start and debug the tinywasm development environment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working with tinywasm for WebAssembly development

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以控制一个本地 Web 开发环境：启动/切换项目、获取项目信息、查看日志，以及通过浏览器工具（导航、点击、填写表单、截图等）与运行中的 Web 应用交互。
howto.when: 当你在 tinywasm 开发环境中工作，并且本地运行了 tinywasm -mcp 守护进程时触发。

say.text: 启动一个新的 tinywasm 项目。
截取当前页面的屏幕截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a local web development environment: start/switch projects, get project info, view logs, and interact with running web apps via browser tools (navigate, click, fill forms, screenshot, etc.).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are working in the tinywasm development environment and the tinywasm -mcp daemon is running locally.

say_en.note: Calls start_development tool; Claude begins a headless project.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page.
say_en.note: Calls browser_screenshot tool; returns page screenshot.
Calls app_get_logs tool; returns logs from BUILD section.
